items.summary: Model ArmorFeatureModel Armor enforces theconstraints/modelarmor.managed.requireTemplateDataResidencyCompliance managedOrganization Policy Service constraint by default. When you create or update a template,this constraint prevents you from setting data_residency_compliant to falseor clearing the Enforce data residency option unless an Organization PolicyAdministrator disables the constraint. This feature is generally available(GA). For moreinformation, seeDisable the organization policy constraint for dataresidency.
